import math
import unittest

from solution import matrix_product


class MatrixProductTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_rectangular_matrix_product(self):
        left = [[1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6]]
        right = [[7, 8], [9, 10], [11, 12]]
        self.assertEqual(matrix_product(left, right), [[58, 64], [139, 154]])

    def test_single_element_and_float_values(self):
        self.assertEqual(matrix_product([[2.5]], [[-2]]), [[-5.0]])

    def test_result_rows_are_independently_allocated(self):
        left = [[1], [2]]
        right = [[3, 4]]
        result = matrix_product(left, right)
        self.assertEqual(result, [[3, 4], [6, 8]])
        self.assertIsNot(result[0], result[1])
        result[0][0] = 999
        self.assertEqual(result[1], [6, 8])

    def test_result_does_not_alias_or_mutate_inputs(self):
        left = [[1, 0], [0, 1]]
        right = [[2, 3], [4, 5]]
        left_before = [row[:] for row in left]
        right_before = [row[:] for row in right]
        result = matrix_product(left, right)
        self.assertEqual(left, left_before)
        self.assertEqual(right, right_before)
        self.assertIsNot(result, left)
        self.assertIsNot(result, right)
        for row in result:
            self.assertTrue(all(row is not input_row for input_row in left + right))
        result[0][0] = -1
        self.assertEqual(right[0][0], 2)

    def test_incompatible_dimensions(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            matrix_product([[1, 2]], [[1, 2]])

    def test_invalid_matrix_shapes(self):
        cases = [
            (None, [[1]]),
            ([], [[1]]),
            ([[]], [[1]]),
            (((1,),), [[1]]),
            ([[1]], None),
            ([[1]], []),
            ([[1]], [[]]),
            ([[1, 2], [3]], [[1], [2]]),
            ([[1, 2]], [[1, 2], [3]]),
        ]
        for left, right in cases:
            with self.subTest(left=left, right=right):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    matrix_product(left, right)

    def test_invalid_entries(self):
        invalid_values = [True, False, None, "1", math.inf, -math.inf, math.nan]
        for value in invalid_values:
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    matrix_product([[value]], [[1]])
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    matrix_product([[1]], [[value]])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
